skills.name: tiny-design
skills.description: How apps, websites, dashboards, presentations and forms built for Tiniest Cloud should look and feel — a direction chosen for the product and its industry, palette and type, layout and balance, motion, light and dark, and the checks before calling it done. Use when designing, building or restyling anything to deploy on Tiniest Cloud. Where the person has design standards of their own (a design system, components, a brand guide, an app to match), those come first and this fills only what they leave open; with none, follow it all.
headings: Design — make it look made for its job

skills.name: tiny
skills.description: Build and deploy static apps to Tiniest Cloud, which gives every app auth, per-user storage, and an LLM with no keys or configuration. Use when building or changing an app hosted on Tiniest Cloud, or when you see tiny.db, tiny.ai, or tiny.rules.json.
